item.title: Agnostic About the Cosmos, Atheist About the Doctrines
item.description: Why one can honestly say "I don't know" about a cosmic creator-force while saying a flat "no" to the bearded god and the risen son — and why religion's usefulness as comfort proves only the usefulness of a lie, not the truth of a single dogma.
